---
title: "Aspirational Leadership"
date: "2008-01-14"
categories: ["Politics"]
---

When it comes to the leadership of the federal parliamentary Liberal Party, [Peter Costello](http://www.smh.com.au/news/national/costello-making-a-move/2008/01/11/1199988590125.html "Peter Costello") remains all aspiration, no application:

> *Mr Costello is considering whether to remain in politics as a backbencher until Dr Nelson is deposed, then lead the Liberal Party to the next election with Malcolm Turnbull as his treasurer.*
